BETA v1.4.2 (13 July 2019) |previous_update = [[BETA v1.3|Outlaw Update]] |next_update = [[BETA v1.5]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''BETA v1.4''' was the fifth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 10th of July 2019. It added two new towers, multiple enemies, [[Titles|Flairs]] and various other changes. As with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was no official name for updates. As a result, the name '''BETA v1.4''' has been retroactively applied to this update. This version encompassed three updates, the main BETA v1.4.0 update (released 10 July 2019) and three minor updates, the BETA v1.4.0a update (released in the same day as the v1.4.0 update, 10 July 2019), the BETA v1.4.1 update (released 11 July 2019) and BETA v1.4.2 (released 13 July 2019). ==Additions== ===Towers=== *[[Military Base]] *[[Crook Boss]] ===Enemies=== *[[Gravekeeper]] *[[Tombstone]] *[[Controlled]] *[[Shrike Crystal]] *[[Chained Boss|Chained]] *[[Witch Doctor]] ===Maps=== *[[Iceville]] *[[Canyon]] *[[Rocket Arena]] ===Miscellaneous=== *[[Default Nametag]] *[[Titles|Flairs]] **Contributor Flair **Moderator Flair **Administrator Flair **Developer Flair **Creator Flair *Wave skip vote *Triumphs leaderboard *New [[Codes|code]]: 10KPLAYERS **Gives from {{Money|100}} to {{Money|150}}. ***Upgrade cost decreased from {{Money|350}} to {{Money|300}}. **'''Level 2''' ***Income increased from {{Money|200}} to {{Money|250}}. ***Upgrade cost decreased from {{Money|650}} to {{Money|600}}. *[[Ranger|Outlaw]] buffed. **'''Base''' ***Cost increased from {{Money|1,250}} to {{Money|2,000}}. ***Damage increased from 4 to 10. **'''Level 1''' ***Damage increased from +1 to +5 **'''Level 3''' ***Firerate changed from {{Tooltip|2.05 > 6.05|+4}} to {{Tooltip|2.05 > 4.05|+2}}. **'''Level 4''' ***Damage increased from +25 to +35. ***Splash damage increased from +37 to +47. **'''Level 5''' ***Firerate changed from {{Tooltip|6.05 > 3.55|-2.5}} to {{Tooltip|4.05 > 3.05|-1}}. ***Damage increased from -10 to +25. ***Splash damage increased from -5 to +13. :In '''BETA v1.4.1''': *[[Military Base]] units name changed. **''Humvee1'' renamed to ''Truck1''. **''Humvee2'' renamed to ''Truck2''. **''Humvee3'' renamed to ''Truck3''. *[[Rocket Arena]] easter egg removed. ===Enemies=== *[[Normal Boss|Boss1]] health decreased from 175 to 125. *[[Slow Boss|Boss2]] health decreased from 1,600 to 1,200. *[[Shock|Lightning]] health increased from 85 to 90. *[[Speedy Boss|Boss3]] health decreased from 3,200 to 2,000. In '''BETA v1.4.0a''': *[[Witch Doctor]] now heals back one sixth of an enemy's health instead of maximum health. ===Miscellaneous=== *Wave bonus increased from {{Money|25}} to {{Money|40}} per wave. *Player walkspeed increased. *Shared cash changed to 25%. *Nerfed [[MEGA Servers]]. *Removed 4th of July decorations from the [[Main Lobby]]. :In '''BETA v1.4.1''': *Instant death bug fixed. :In '''BETA v1.4.2''': *Cash bug fixed. ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate as this is transcribed from the game's description. Several things may be incorrect and there may be things that are missing.'' ===BETA v1.4.0=== *[[Military Base]] [UNIT] (motor,humvee,tank,etc.) **($2750 credits ingame) *[[Crook Boss]] [UNIT] **(obtained at lvl. 30 OR bought via the gamepass for next three days.) *[[Iceville]] [MAP] *[[Canyon]] [MAP] *[[Rocket Arena|Blast Zone]] [MAP] *Name Tags *Wave skip vote *[[Gravekeeper]] [Zombie] *[[Chained]] [Zombie] *[[Controlled]] [Zombie] *Triumphs leaderboard *10KPLAYERS [[Codes|code]] added. *Improved bonus wave cash *Increased walkspeed *Buffed [[Outlaw]] & [[Farm]] *[[Outlaw]]: **LVL 0 now deals 10 damage up from 4. **LVL 3 now only changes fire-rate to 4 down from 6. **LVL 5 now increases fire-rate to 3. **Outlaw also no longer suffers a damage penalty and does 120 damage when maxed. *[[Farm]]: **LVL 1 and 2 are now $50 cheaper and give $50 more cash. **Shared cash is now 25% *Slightly nerfed mega servers *Tons of bug fixes ===BETA v1.4.1=== *[[Rocket Arena]] easter egg removed *Instakill bug fixed ===BETA v1.4.2=== *Cash bug fixed {{UpdateNavBox}} [[Category:BETA Updates]]
